characters.name: Ali G
characters.description: A cappella: Ali G is a wannabe hip-hop artist and he would do beatboxing from time to time, often improvising on the topic that was discussed. As if the guests were not trolled enough already. Back from the Dead: After performing aHeroic Sacrifice, he goes to Heaven but is sent back. Big Damn Heroes: He busts down a wall to save an Asian woman from her captor, and she rewards him with sex. The Ditz:When he is told the sun is too hot to be walked on, he asks if it can be walked on if it is winter.Asks if Disneyland is part of the UN, and if it will somehow be after a hundred years.When he is told about the seats of the UN, he asks if you can swap them if the person next to you is annoying. When he is told the sun is too hot to be walked on, he asks if it can be walked on if it is winter.

characters.name: Borat
characters.description: As Long as It Sounds Foreign: Borat's Kazakh is actually mostly Hebrew. He also writes his notes in Hebrew, which has almost given up the joke on at least one occasion. Black Comedy Rape: Borat's entitled views towards the female sex are played for laughs; he is surprised when he is told he has to ask for consent to sleep with a woman. Bread, Eggs, Milk, Squick: Borat says, "In Kazakhstan we have many hobbies: disco dancing, archery, rape, and table tennis." Catchphrase: "Jagshamesh!" Jerkass: He is quite misogynistic, often speaking of women as if they are objects and admits to abusing animals for fun. Plus, because of his upbringing he thinks abuse and rape is normal.

characters.name: Bruno
characters.description: Funny Foreigner: Bruno is an Austrian with a thick accent, and also verycamp. Jerkass: Is prone to insulting everyone he meets, and also finds the fact that homeless people can't buy clothes funny. He also jokes about putting people with bad fashion sense "on a train andsay bye bye!".
